verdict.rationale: Datadog documents its own API Reference at docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest/, with a markdown version for AI agents, so the core reference artifact exists. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or offers runnable examples, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. missing for 10: evidence of interactive try-it/runnable request examples, code samples per endpoint, a published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: For AI agents: A markdown version of this page is available at https://docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest.md
